text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多画风场景20组 · 07 · 赛璐璐动画 · 海风天台天文社 · 钴蓝 / 暖白 / 珊瑚橙.
Environment: Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. High quality hand-drawn 2D cel-animation environment background, coastal magic academy rooftop astronomy classroom, brass telescope and circular star-chart desk, crisp purposeful linework, carefully painted clean shapes, cobalt summer sky, warm white masonry and coral roof tiles, airy empty foreground, no written symbols.
Visual medium: cel animation; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Reconstruct the SAME scene from reference 1 concept plan, reference 2 original look. Match plan footprint, fixed window/door/stair/furniture positions. Scene: 多画风场景20组 · 07 · 赛璐璐动画 · 海风天台天文社 · 钴蓝 / 暖白 / 珊瑚橙. One flat architectural orthographic main facade elevation or interior principal wall elevation. Show openings, structural bays, vertical proportions, ceiling profile and material detail. No perspective montage, no furniture moved against the elevation. White page, title INTERIOR ELEVATION or FRONT ELEVATION. Preserve reference materials, light and style. Unseen extension conservative. Empty environment, NO people, animals, silhouettes, statues of humans, no unrelated spaces. Landscape image, no dimensions. IMPORTANT: Reference 2 ORIGINAL image determines artistic medium and color grading; keep watercolor / impasto painting / cel animation / clay miniature respectively. Reference 1 only determines spatial layout, NOT render style. Do not homogenize all scenes into photorealism.
